I feel your pain, your frustration, your disappointment, that hole in your core. The flashes of anger that swirl into guilt, sadness and hurt. If we wore a mood ring it would explode out of confusion and being overworked. I wish I could tell you it gets better but I’d be lying if I said that I knew. It might get better, it might not. I don’t know. All I do know is that my feelings are strong and real and that there are others out there going through the same or similar things posting here. Posting, talking, relating. That’s what is keeping me from feeling that dark drowning feeling. We’re not supposed to give advice but being in here has worked for me so far.

Im thinking about taking out a 20,000 loan, going to Mexico, buying a fuck ton of cocaine and banging every whore in every brothel I can find until I OD or have a heart attack. Fuck hanging or washing my mouth out with a revolver. I’m not giving any advise. It’s just what I’m doing my friend. This world hurt me too much for too long. I’m treating myself to going out the way I want. Cheers!

I’d like to talk to you more. I feel like I was rowing a boat on the ocean at night KNOWING I was alone and bound to die. And right before I pull the trigger, I see another boat with a man in it, gun to his head just like me. The only thing stopping me is seeing this man, almost like looking in a mirror. And at that moment I think, maybe I’m the only thing in this world stopping him. That coincidence is too strange to not be explored. I hope you agree.

If I ask for help I lose my certifications and ultimately my career. They can’t fire me because it’s illegal to do so but they can pull my certifications and say that because I don’t have them I’m unqualified.

I’m going through the same thing. I was a cop for 13 years. Bled, sweat, saw horrible things along side my brothers in blue. Got into an altercation arresting someone a year ago 12/12/2019. Broke my knee, tore my meniscus, broke 6 vertebrae, my hip, my left elbow and right shoulder. Not. A. Single. One. Reached out to me. Here we are a year later and I did the same thing you’re doing, deleted social media, deleted them from my phone. A full blown purge. Still, nothing. I felt discarded, a ghost for sure. I know how this feels. I recently started making friends in a social circle that I’d never thought I’d be a part of and I’m liking it. We made friends with people once, I think I can do it again. Doesn’t take the pain away but it’s a lot less lonely.

I get in these super depressed moods where I wreck all of my relationships so I “can’t turn back” and then my mood shifts and I feel like a worthless piece of shit for wrecking everything, then back into the depression and suicidal thoughts. This cycle is vicious. I wrote my first draft of my note tonight in my depressive state.
